name: eevee_taa_soft_shadow_history_reset
purpose: Verify that an Eevee rendered viewport with temporal reprojection and jittered soft shadows discards stale film history when a shadow receiver transform changes.
passCriteria: The test warms a rendered viewport, moves the shadow receiver, captures the first post-update viewport frame, and compares it with a fresh reference at the same receiver position. The mean image difference must stay low and the changed-frame comparison must include non-trivial lit/shadow content, so old Combined history cannot be stretched across the receiver after the scene update.
